description: Find conferences, see who is going and why, judge people against your target customer, and save the ones worth meeting.

interface.shortDescription: Who to meet at any conference
interface.longDescription: Prompt Prospect finds the people worth meeting at a conference before you go. Pick an event from the catalog or paste its website; research reads the event's pages and LinkedIn posts and lists the speakers, sponsors, exhibitors and engaged attendees with the evidence that puts them there. Describe your target customer once, and Check fit judges every person against it so the matches sort to the top. Save the ones you want to meet, add notes, and export the list. Research is included; Check fit spends the workspace's credits and asks before it starts.
defaultPrompt: Which fintech conferences are near Chicago in the next three months?
Who at Money20/20 USA is a head of compliance at a bank?
Add HLTH 2026 and research who is going.
Check fit for everyone at my next event and show the strong matches.
